prompt: The dashboard assigns each request to its opening district, but a request closed and then reopened keeps its original district. This week, East logged fewer new requests, West logged more, and an East request reopened from a West office. Citywide new-request volume did not change, so the district chart should _____.
promptZh: 儀表板按案件首次開立的行政區分類；結案後重開的案件仍保留原開立區。本週東區的新案減少、西區增加，另有一件東區案件由西區辦公室重開。全市新案數沒變，因此各區圖表應_____。

options.text: show no district change and leave the reopened case under East
options.zh: 顯示各區無變化，並把重開案件留在東區
options.whyZh: 全市合計不變，並不代表各區個別不變。

options.text: show more new requests in West and fewer in East, and credit the reopening to West
options.zh: 顯示西區新案增加、東區減少，並將重開列到西區
options.whyZh: 各區新案方向正確，但重開地點不是原開立區。

options.text: show more new requests in West and fewer in East, and keep the reopened case under East
options.zh: 顯示西區新案增加、東區減少，並把重開案件留在東區
options.whyZh: 需呈現互相抵銷的分區變化，重開案沿用最初開立區，不新增一筆。

options.text: show the district shift and count the reopening as a second new request in East
options.zh: 顯示各區變化，並把重開案件算作東區另一件新案
options.whyZh: 重開是保留原案，不是再次開立。

explanationZh: 需呈現互相抵銷的分區變化，重開案沿用最初開立區，不新增一筆。
evidence: keeps its original district / East logged fewer new requests, West logged more / Citywide new-request volume did not change

vocabulary.note: 可修飾統計量或措施，表示範圍是整座城市，而非單一行政區。
